policy.fullVerifyWhen: capability-wide change, Linux-equivalent claim, or the maintainer asks
policy.packageProfile: optional; a Windows BYOK timeout is not a ship blocker
policy.releaseCliPullRequest: pnpm release:cli may call gh pr create after the tag push; ignore that failure; do not retry; fast-forward release/vX.Y.Z into main with git

welcomeChangelog.rule: The first ## X.Y.Z heading wins. Put this release's Talos bullets first, then copy the previous Welcome bullets. Do not use underscore in those notes; Welcome strips it.

never: move or recreate a tag after npm or a GitHub Release has referenced it
open a GitHub pull request for the feature or the version bump
change Classic from the default TUI skin
write build or tarball output inside the repository

steps.do: Write the first ## X.Y.Z changelog sections (EN+ZH), docs/releases/X.Y.Z.md, README current-version lines, and the changelog test. Scan upstream PRs; append a release: proceed row or stop on P0. New paths: node scripts/source-inventory.mjs --write.
Commit feature work plus notes on the feature branch. Working tree must be clean. Source export reads committed HEAD.
Fill docs/releases/X.Y.Z.md Validation and docs/verification.md with the windows-profile SHA. Commit on the feature branch.

steps.command: gh release create vX.Y.Z --repo PAKIKNOWLEDGE/Talos-Code-CLI --title "Talos CLI X.Y.Z" --notes-file docs/releases/X.Y.Z.md --latest $env:TEMP\talos-release\pakiknowledge-tal0s-code-X.Y.Z.tar.gz $env:TEMP\talos-release\pakiknowledge-tal0s-code-X.Y.Z.tar.gz.sha256

steps.do: On main, record npm + GitHub Release in docs/verification.md. Commit and push. Do not tag this docs commit.
